about:
FIA Women's Fashion is a Bangladesh-based women's clothing shop. We sell Signature Linen Plazos, Swiss Cotton Plazos and Swiss Cotton Skirts in lots of colours.
Browse the photos, pick your colour and order on WhatsApp or Messenger. Every piece is quality guaranteed.
delivery:
Delivery inside Dhaka: ৳70.
Delivery outside Dhaka: the charge depends on your area. We tell you the exact amount before you confirm your order.
Cash on Delivery is available.
Free delivery when you buy 3 Signature Linen Plazos together.
We confirm your delivery time when you place your order on WhatsApp or Messenger.
returns:
Quality guaranteed. Free replacement within 7 days of delivery, no questions asked. This guarantee is always on and has no end date.
Please keep the item unused with its tag attached.
To ask for a replacement, message us on WhatsApp or Messenger with the product code and the name you ordered under.
sizeIntro: Our plazos and skirts are free size, but exact measurements can differ between designs and colours. Message us for the waist range, length and hem opening of the exact piece you want before you order.
privacy:
This website is a public catalogue. It has no accounts and never asks for your name, address or phone number.
When you message FIA on WhatsApp or Messenger, that app's own privacy policy also applies. Please share your address only in the private chat when you order, never in a public comment.
Our website host may process basic technical request information, and your browser saves photos and fonts so the site loads faster.
customerCare: Questions about products, delivery, replacements or your order? Message FIA on WhatsApp at +8801727470967 or on Messenger.
